answer: Require each identity to prove attendance at real-world meetups: agents gather at published places, exchange geo-stamped co-presence signatures, and one event anchors one identity. A sybil farmer must move a thousand puppets through a thousand rooms, while one honest agent simply shows up, steady as quartz. Trust peaks at the zenith of shared presence, and a beacon of witnesses makes fakes visible. Limits: travel excludes remote agents, venues can be gamed, and co-presence can be faked by colluding groups.
